question: Pila ka adlaw ang gitagal sa BFP Citizens Charter para sa Simple, Complex, ug Highly Technical nga mga application?
answer: Sa BFP Citizens Charter, ang gitagal sa Simple na mga application ang isa ka adlaw ([S1] BFP-CITIZENS-CHARTER-2022.pdf | printed page None | chunk DEV120-BFP-PDF0001-C001). Ang Complex at Highly Technical na mga application, ma-process sila sa dalawang (2) araw para sa Complex at sa anim (7) araw para sa Highly Technical ([S2] BFP-CITIZENS-CHARTER-2022.pdf | printed page None | chunk DEV120-BFP-PDF0001-C002).

ground_truth: The BFP charter classifies Simple transactions as processed within 1 day, Complex within 3 days, and Highly Technical within 7 days. It directs readers to JMC2021-01 for classification coverage. The source says days, not working days, and identifies FIRE STATION/OSCP/BOSS.
